title: Rescheduling Terms for Specimen Collection Appointments
content:
## Terms in force

1. **Booked visits only.** A Specimen Collection Appointments visit can be rescheduled only while its status is booked, as the system record of that visit shows it.
2. **Number of moves.** A visit may be rescheduled at most the visit type's published number of times (the most reschedules per visit). When the visit has already been rescheduled that many times, it cannot be moved again; the patient cancels and books a new visit instead.
3. **The new date and time.** The new date and time must satisfy the booking policy as of the day of the change.
4. **The new date stands.** A reschedule that carries a charge keeps its new date; the charge does not undo the move.
5. **Recollection visits.** A visit whose purpose is recollection never carries a rescheduling fee where the visit type waives collection-service fees on recollection visits.

## Retired terms — no longer in force

The following former terms of rescheduling are **no longer in force** and are not applied:

- the former term that a reschedule made at or beyond the visit type's free-change notice in hours before the current appointment start is free;
- the former term that a reschedule made with less notice, on a visit type whose late-cancellation fee is above 0.00, assesses that fee once, exactly as a late cancellation would;
- the former term that notice of a reschedule is measured in elapsed hours from the moment the change is recorded to the current appointment date and time, with a change at exactly the free-change notice counting as timely.

The charge on a late move of a home visit, and how its notice is counted, now follow the current late-change basis for home visits.

## Cases (hypothetical visits)

| Visit | Times already rescheduled | Most reschedules for the type | Status | Can it be moved under these terms? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mobile In-Home Collection Visit | 1 | 2 | Booked | Yes, if the new date and time satisfy the booking policy on the day of the change |
| Mobile In-Home Collection Visit | 2 | 2 | Booked | No — the patient cancels and books a new visit |
| Pediatric Collection Appointment | 0 | 3 | Checked in | No — only a booked visit can be rescheduled |
| Patient Service Center Walk-In Visit | 0 | 0 | — | No — the type allows no reschedule |

superseded_clauses: A reschedule made at or beyond free_change_notice_hours before the current appointment start is free
a reschedule made with less notice on a visit type whose late_cancellation_fee is above 0.00 assesses that fee once, exactly as a late cancellation would
Notice is measured in elapsed hours from the moment the change is recorded to the current appointment date and time, and a change at exactly free_change_notice_hours counts as timely.
